rubric.basis: Volume is not a factor: the tier follows uncertainty and the consequence of an error (PROTO-DEC-0074 item 4, 0075 item 8). The six factors operationalize the four parameters of 0075 item 8: Novelty and Ambiguity (uncertainty and reasoning depth), Reversibility and Protected paths (the consequence of an error), Coupling (cross-system coupling) and Independent judgement (the independent judgement required). Context window, modality, tools, route capability and language support are hard constraints, checked when the route is resolved, not scored.
rubric.reviewOnly: Hard floors: a certification is at least T7, and so is a task that directly creates, changes or applies a candidate kernel record, kernel code or protocol tooling. A research, design or review frame that produces only advisory artefacts does not take that floor because its result may later change the kernel, and a review-only task takes the rubric's tier unless another rule sets a higher floor (PROTO-DEC-0072). A protected path is at least T4.
